title: Doctrine: size and the bad day
dek: Inner reasoning wing: size starts as a dollar loss budget, and size is set off the worst priced day, worked on the book's own numbers.

claims.text: At the October 23, 2026 marks: all five plays are unproven, on quarter-unit loss budgets ($62,500 each), P2 paused in the supply scare. The book's worst priced day is $7,918 against $129,283 added up play by play, a cancellation difference of $121,365: the collar insures the same length the overwrite sits on, so the pair counts as one position. The normal-day yardstick, $3,840, prints as the cross-check.
